Senses.Explanation: A further barrier names an additional gate beyond an earlier passage, commonly in lines about penetrating or emerging through layered barriers. The expression is broadly attested. Counts range from one to ten thousand barriers; one passes, breaks, opens, guards, or remains separated by them. Yuantong Daomin warns, ‘do not say no-mind is the Way; no-mind still leaves one further barrier.’ Dun'an Zongyan asks who in the assembly has passed it. An unnamed monk asks Daxiu Zhu to present ‘the final barrier,’ while another unnamed monk asks how to pass ‘this barrier’ and Xueguan Zhiyin directs him to ‘ask the gatekeeper.’ Baoshou Xin speaks of going straight through two barriers, and Wuzu Fayan speaks of passing four. A late discourse by the Yongzheng Emperor gives its own named description of ‘passing through the further barrier’; this is preserved as that text’s account, not made universal. Zen bends the checkpoint image into a public measure, but the corpus names no fixed numbered stage shared by every use.

Occurrences.Kwic: ，則渠全無渠，而渠即是汝，言渠者亦非也。是一涉名言，便成染污，豈妙契斯道之意哉？如世嬰兒，五相完具，不去不來，不起不住，婆婆和和，有句無句，終不得物，語未正故。涅槃經云：云何名嬰兒行？善男子！不能起、住、去、來、語言，是名嬰兒行。如來亦爾，不能起者，如來終不起諸法相；不能住者，如來不著一切諸法；不能來者，如來身行無有動搖；不能去者，如來已到大涅槃；不能語者，如來為諸眾生演說諸法，實無所說。經中舉嬰兒行以例如來之行，今舉以例法中具五位也。重離六爻，偏正回互，疊而為三，變盡成五。偏正回互，謂陰陽變易也。疊而為三者，謂疊變至三爻也。變盡成五者，以上三爻變，則成水火既濟卦，象正中偏。以下三爻變，則成火水未濟卦，象偏中正。以中間互體三四五爻變，則成風雷益卦，象兼中至。以二三四爻變，則成山澤損卦，象兼中到。既未二卦，以火配偏，以水配正，其義可見。損益二卦，皆出於互，即兼義也。風雷俱動，象兼至之發於用。山澤俱靜，象兼到之歸於體。離本卦象正中來，以離乃心象，心居一身之中。又正中來，象內黑而外白，正離之

Senses.Explanation: Ācārya is a title or direct form of address for a monastic instructor; in ordination compounds it can designate the office-holder who performs a defined ceremonial role. In encounters the title is often spoken directly to the person being questioned or answered. The bare title does not by itself decide rank, lineage, or ordination office.
